headline: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to connect research AI with drug-development operations
summary: OpenAI says it has acquired Orchestra Bio, a platform for coordinating drug-development programs, and will combine the company's team and technology with its Rosalind life-sciences tools. Orchestra Bio's own site says it is joining OpenAI. The two company statements confirm the bounded acquisition event, but neither establishes measured research productivity, drug-discovery or treatment outcomes, transaction terms, or the breadth of integration.
